annotations.title: asksteps: list the ready-made form templates

description: Lists the ready-made templates that ship with asksteps — contact form, quote request, callback and so on. Prefer starting from one of these over building a form from nothing: a template brings its design and its success page along, which the plain form structure cannot describe. Pass the id to asksteps_create_from_template, then change the texts with asksteps_update_form.

type.description: Restrict to "form" (a flat multi-step form) or "funnel" (one question at a time). Omit for both.

name: asksteps_list_templates

stepCount.description: How many steps (or questions) and fields (or answers) it has, so you can say what the user will get.

type.description: Either "form" (a flat multi-step form) or "funnel" (one question at a time, with branching).
